evidence.text: Wu Yifan -LRB- , pronounced -LSB- - cmnu2-i4fan4 -RSB- , ; born November 6 , 1990 -RRB- , professionally known as Kris Wu or Kris , is a Chinese-born Canadian actor , singer , and model .
Wu or Wumen School is a group of painters of the Southern School during the Ming period of Chinese history .
A Wu School painting is characterized by inscriptions describing the painting , the date , method , or reason for the work , which is usually seen as a vehicle for personal expression .
Shen Zhou -LRB- 1427 -- 1509 -RRB- is usually cited as the founder of the Wu School .
The Zhe School is usually referenced in opposition to the Wu School .
